details.description: No documentation exists explaining how to set up or install the project. Developers cannot determine prerequisites or installation steps.
details.why_required: Without installation instructions, developers cannot determine if they have the right environment or how to prepare the project for use.
details.code_evidence: package.json defines the project as 'simple-task-runner' with a start script, but no README explains how to use npm commands or what prerequisites are needed. The project uses Node.js (evident from .js files and package.json) but this requirement is never documented.

details.description: No documentation explains how to run the task runner or what command-line arguments are expected.
details.why_required: Developers need to know how to execute the program and what parameters to provide. The entry point expects specific command-line arguments.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js reads process.argv[2] for taskName and package.json has 'npm start' script, but no documentation explains how to invoke tasks or what the command syntax is.

details.description: No documentation lists what tasks are available to run or what they do.
details.why_required: Developers need to know which task names are valid. The code will throw 'Unknown task' errors for invalid names.
details.code_evidence: src/tasks.js exports two tasks: 'build' and 'test'. These are the only valid task names, but without documentation, developers must read the source code to discover them.

details.description: No documentation explains what errors can occur and how to resolve them.
details.why_required: Developers need to understand error messages and their solutions to troubleshoot issues.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js throws 'Error: Task name is required' when no argument is provided. src/taskRunner.js throws 'Error: Unknown task: ${name}' for invalid task names. These error conditions are not documented.

details.description: No documentation explains the project architecture, file organization, or the purpose of each module.
details.why_required: Developers need to understand the codebase structure to modify or extend it effectively.
details.code_evidence: The project has three main files (input.js, taskRunner.js, tasks.js) with distinct responsibilities, but no documentation explains their roles or how they interact. input.js is the entry point, taskRunner.js contains execution logic, and tasks.js is the task registry.

details.description: No documentation explains how to add new tasks or extend functionality.
details.why_required: Developers who want to customize or extend the task runner need guidance on how to add tasks without breaking existing functionality.
details.code_evidence: src/tasks.js is a simple object exporting task functions. Adding a new task requires adding a new property with a function value, but this pattern is not documented.

details.description: No documentation specifies Node.js version requirements or operating system compatibility.
details.why_required: Developers need to know if their environment is compatible before attempting to use the project.
details.code_evidence: The project uses Node.js features (require, module.exports, process.argv) but doesn't document which Node.js versions are supported or tested.

details.description: No high-level description of what the project is or what problem it solves.
details.why_required: Developers need context to understand if this project meets their needs and what its intended use case is.
details.code_evidence: package.json names the project 'simple-task-runner' but provides no description field. No README exists to explain the project's purpose or use cases.
